title: VTA DIDs — Recover — payload
description: Ask a Verifiable Trust Agent to take over a key-role identity whose VTA was lost, with the identity's committed recovery key (CONVENTIONS.md §9.5; VTI-KEY-117). The recovering VTA generates new keys, and the recovery custodian signs the one change that publishes them.

did.description: The key-role identity, by DID (for a `did:scid` identity, the DID without `src`).

contextId.description: Context of this (the recovering) VTA the identity is placed in.

history.description: The identity's published history as the method profile names it (for did:webvh, `did.jsonl` and, when witnessed, `did-witness.json`). Absent, the VTA resolves it. The VTA verifies it in full either way and never trusts it for being supplied.

lostKeys.description: `destroyed` — the lost VTA's keys are gone, not stolen: its attestation keys are retired, and what they signed stays valid (VTI-KEY-132). `mayBeExposed` — they may be in someone else's hands: every lost key is revoked from `compromisedSince`.

methodParameters.description: Validated against the profile's `UpdateParameters`, for a recovery that also moves hosting or witnesses.

recoveryCommitment.description: The fresh recovery key that replaces the one this recovery uses (VTI-KEY-128).

recoveryProof.description: The recovery custodian's proof over `preview.recoverySigning.unsignedChange`, in the method profile's form. Absent until the custodian has signed; a request without it is answered `awaitingRecoveryProof`.

expectedVersionId.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition: the version identifier (method profile §3) the caller based this change on, for example `keys/list`'s `versionId`. The VTA MUST refuse with `vta/dids:versionConflict` if the identity has moved past it. Not optional for anything a person looked at.

dryRun.description: Compute and return the preview without writing anything but the plan (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1). Absent reads as false.

previewId.description: Apply exactly the plan a previous dry run of this same request returned, or nothing (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1); what every approval is bound to.

reason.description: Why the change is being made, for the audit trail and for the other approvers. Never published.

preview.description: Present when `outcome` is `preview`, `pendingApproval` or `awaitingRecoveryProof`: the plan, and what an approval is bound to.

newVersionId.description: Present when `outcome` is `applied`: the version identifier of the change. Pass it as the next change's `expectedVersionId`.

keys.description: Every key whose state this change sets or would set, after the change.
